# Tessa Carrow

## Overview

- **Age:** Six years old  <sub>[v5 c1 P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003), [v5 c7 P16](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0016)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v5 c1 P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003)</sub>

## Appearance

Tessa is a plump, rotund little child with red, curly hair and hazel eyes that crinkle shut when she falls asleep. She is dressed by Tabitha in fine garments, including pale, worked frocks, blue sashes, beaded slippers, and fancy hats adorned with silk, lace, and blossoms.

_Sources: [v5 c1 P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003), [v5 c7 P1](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0001)_

## Personality

Tessa possesses a prideful, somewhat prim nature and takes immense delight in wearing fine clothes. She is extremely dutiful when given tasks, resolutely carrying out instructions despite opposition. However, she is easily terrified by strange or intimidating behavior.

_Sources: [v5 c7 P0](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0000), [v5 c7 P1](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0001), [v5 c7 P7](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0007), [v5 c7 P12](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0012), [v5 c7 P14](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0014)_

## Traits

- Proud  <sub>[v5 c7 P0](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0000), [v5 c7 P1](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0001)</sub>
- Prim  <sub>[v5 c7 P0](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0000)</sub>
- Dutiful  <sub>[v5 c7 P0](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0000), [v5 c7 P7](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0007)</sub>
- Vain about her attire  <sub>[v5 c7 P1](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0001), [v5 c7 P20](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0020)</sub>

## History

Tessa Carrow grew up at Hollowmere as the youngest child of Nell and Dr. Hugh Carrow, routinely thrashed by Tabitha whenever it was believed her spiritual well-being required it. She was given the task of delivering a basket of early strawberries to the manse, with strict instructions from Tabitha to give them only to Aunt Martha or Mr. Ashdown. Upon arriving at the manse hill, she was confronted by Mary Stubbs, who attempted to take the basket. Tessa steadfastly refused to hand it over, which provoked Mary to mock her vanity, perform an uncanny dance, and chase her down the Glen street while brandishing a dried codfish. Terrified, Tessa fled and dropped the basket, crushing the strawberries, before tripping into a mud puddle. Miss Winifred rescued her from the ordeal and carried her home, though Tessa's pride and fine garments were severely ruined by the event. She later studied her primers on the veranda with Tabitha and Harcourt, and joined her siblings on a visit to Julian and Damaris Treleaven at the House of Dreams.

_Sources: [v5 c1 P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003), [v5 c1 P5](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0005), [v5 c7 P0](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0000), [v5 c7 P1](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0001), [v5 c7 P3](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0003), [v5 c7 P7](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0007), [v5 c7 P9](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0009), [v5 c7 P10](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0010), [v5 c7 P14](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0014), [v5 c7 P15](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0015), [v5 c7 P16](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0016), [v5 c26 P8](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0008), [v5 c30 P1](../source/v05-c30.md#nw-v05-c30-p0001)_
